reviewer: Codex default model; direct image inspection
method: Each native and round-trip still viewed directly; every film frame inspected on twelve numbered contact sheets. Rejected first slash framing was also inspected in full.
verdict: Publish within accepted V4 scope, with documented visual limitations. Rear serration removed; eyes/lips clearer; full swing now contained in frame.
limitations: Face below approved portrait quality: faceted cheeks/jaw, pale highlights, soft original brows, coarse hairline.
Open fingers accepted; sword seated but no closed grip.
Stiff cloth, residual fold faceting and severe isolated edge stretches remain.
Native subsurface is not exactly represented by core glTF.
